description: This file contains utility functions for Linux network interface management, including getting and setting interface states, MAC addresses, interface indices, and vendor information, as well as VLAN and bridge interface checks.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getNetSock
methods.description: Creates and returns a socket for network interface operations.

methods.name: s_getIfFlags
methods.description: Retrieves interface flags using ioctl.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getState
methods.description: Checks if the interface is up.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getStateExt
methods.description: Gets interface state using a new socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getLinkState
methods.description: Checks if the link is active based on interface flags.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getLinkStateExt
methods.description: Gets link state with a new socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_setState
methods.description: Sets the administrative state (up/down) of an interface.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_setStateExt
methods.description: Sets interface state using a new socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_setMac
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of an interface.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_setMacExt
methods.description: Sets MAC address with a new socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getMac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of an interface.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getMacExt
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address with a new socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getIfIndex
methods.description: Gets the interface index.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getIfIndexExt
methods.description: Gets interface index with a new socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_updateMac
methods.description: Updates the MAC address of an interface, toggling interface down if needed.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_updateMacExt
methods.description: Updates MAC address with a new socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getChipsetVendor
methods.description: Determines the vendor of the chipset based on driver name.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_isVlanIface
methods.description: Checks if an interface is a VLAN interface.

methods.name: s_getLowerIface
methods.description: Extracts lower interface name from interface name.

methods.name: s_filterLowers
methods.description: Filters directory entries to find lower interfaces.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getLowerIfaces
methods.description: Retrieves lower interfaces for a given interface.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getVlanLowerIface
methods.description: Gets the lower interface for a VLAN interface.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_inBridge
methods.description: Checks if an interface is part of a bridge.
